description: This file contains utility functions for V4L2 (Video4Linux2) media processing, including converting V4L2 enums and structures to string representations for debugging or logging.

methods.name: V4L2MemoryToString
methods.description: Converts a v4l2_memory enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: V4L2FormatToString
methods.description: Converts a v4l2_format structure to a detailed string describing its contents.

methods.name: V4L2BufferToString
methods.description: Converts a v4l2_buffer structure to a detailed string describing its contents.
